name: enterprise-project-allocation-agents
description: Hands-on implementation of the IEEE paper MCP-AI: a multi-agent LLM architecture for automated enterprise project allocation. Root orchestration for local-first dev.
author: javakishore-veleti

scripts.start: npm run local:docker:start-all && npm run local:apps:start-all
scripts.stop: npm run local:apps:stop-all && npm run local:docker:stop-all
scripts.local:apps:start-all: npm run local:apps:middleware:start-all && npm run local:apps:portals:start-all
scripts.local:apps:stop-all: npm run local:apps:portals:stop-all && npm run local:apps:middleware:stop-all
scripts.local:apps:middleware:start-all: npm run secrets:gen && bash DevOps/Local/docker-all-up.sh middleware

scripts_comment: npm start = local:docker:start-all (postgres, observability, airflow, vectordb, datalake, agents) + local:apps:start-all (middleware + portals). local:apps:start-all internally invokes middleware:start-all then portals:start-all. All scripts wrap DevOps/Local/docker-all-{up,down,status}.sh; middleware:start-all runs secrets:gen first.
